user.title: TV Channel Watcher
user.description: Watches which live-TV channel is currently tuned. Two modes — pick whichever this TV's firmware actually supports (some TCL firmware exposes neither the channel name nor the channel database any other way): 'Settings key' gently polls one system setting; 'Live log stream' keeps a permanent connection open and catches the channel name the instant it's logged, for firmware that doesn't have that setting at all. Either way, only the raw value is exposed — turning it into a nicer name is done with your own template sensor, grown at your own pace.

data.host: TV IP address (Live log stream mode only)
data.port: ADB port (Live log stream mode only)

data_description.media_player_entity_id: The same adb-capable media_player entity already used for adb commands on this TV.
data_description.mode: Settings key: polls a system setting (works on some TCL firmware). Live log stream: keeps a permanent connection open and reads the channel name from the TV's own log the instant it changes (for firmware with no such setting).
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between checks. Lower is faster to notice a channel change; higher is gentler on the TV. A single check is a tiny, near-instant shell command either way. Ignored in Live log stream mode.
data_description.host: The TV's IP address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.50 — needed because this mode opens its own direct connection to the TV instead of going through the existing Android TV integration.
data_description.port: The TV's ADB port. Almost always 5555, the same one already used to control it.

error.host_required_for_logcat_stream: TV IP address is required for Live log stream mode.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already being watched.
